meta.title: SkyTrixx Airline Commercial Analytics
meta.note: Synthetic prototype data — 50,000 Air India coupon records across 5,000 flight sectors (USD), Jan 2024–Dec 2025.

grain.coupon: One row = one flown passenger coupon on one flight leg.
grain.capacity: One row = one operated flight sector/date (full plane totals).
grain.warning: Coupon sheet samples 10 rows per flight. Capacity Flown_PAX is the full flight total — do not treat sample coupon count as total passengers.
